settings.control: 16A at the rate, 16B at its August 2024 bottom-hole pressure (wellbore model)
settings.temperature: GDR 1205 model minus the local correction δ (geotherm.correction), one draw per member

correction.method: Per well, δ(z) = a + b·(z − z_ref)/1000 (model − measured, °C) over the open-interval TVDs ± 150 m, against the GDR 1421 16A log of 16 Aug 2021 (for 16B, the log at the same TVD); 50 m block bootstrap; minus a 0-2 °C log-recovery allowance; cells weighted between the two wells by inverse distance squared; checked against the GDR 1608 16B gauge recovery fit

minifrac_1570.note: ISIP from a straight line in √Δt 2-30 s after shut-in; an ISIP is an upper bound of the closure pressure.
